newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sabena to start Toulouse flights Sept 1.
newsitem.headline: Sabena to start Toulouse flights Sept 1.

text.p: Belgian carrier Sabena will start daily flights to Toulouse on September 1, a Sabena spokesman said.

The flights will be operated with an Avro RJ 85, the belly capacity of which will be handled by Swisscargo. Companies such as aircraft manufacturer, Airbus and electronics company Thomson are based in Toulouse.

One June 1, the Belgian carrier started flights to Zagreb under a code-share agreement with Swiss Air. Sabena flies a Avro RJ 100 to Zurich and then the flights are operated by Swiss Air with an MD-80 to Zagreb. Holding group SAirGroup which includes Swissair owns 49.5 percent of Sabena.
Sabena's flights to Brazzaville are still suspended though the company resumed flights to Kinshasa on May 29.
